validity.researcher_notes: Existence and core specs CONFIRM against the wiki page's own cited source, read live (not cited): a Waha Oil Company (شركة الواحة للنفط) news post dated 2020-11-23, 'Gas from the strategic Fargh field reaches its final stage' (غاز حقل الفارغ الإستراتيجي يبلغ مرحلته النهائية). Live URL (wahaoil.ly) returned 403 to the verifier/WebFetch (bot-wall), so I pulled the Wayback snapshot instead (per standing false-negative guidance) — that passed url_verifier (200, contains الواحة/2020/السرير/الفارغ). The article explicitly names 'the line connecting to Sarir station, 97 km long' (بالخط الواصل إلى محطة السرير بطول 97 كم) and later calls it 'the Fargh-Sarir line' (خط الفارغ-السرير) — an exact, non-generic match to this row's name (GEM Length=97.00 km matches exactly), operator (شركة الواحة للنفط = Waha Oil Company, matches GEM Operator field verbatim), fuel (gas), and start year (announcement is dated Nov 2020, describing final tests before full startup 'within a few days' — consistent with GEM StartYear1=2020). This is a real, correctly-named, correctly-classified transmission line (Fargh gas field to Sarir gas station, onward-feeding the Intisar A field per the article's own text — so it is NOT a duplicate of P3987 Intisar–Sarir Gas Pipeline, which is a separate, longer (235 km) downstream segment of the same network; P1861 Farigh-Intesar Gas Pipeline is also a distinct line, different length (177 km) and destination, same source field but not the same route — flagging the naming similarity for awareness only, not a duplicate). CAVEAT: I could only get ONE independently-readable corroborating source — the wiki page's second citation (a Facebook post) returned 200 but its content is behind Facebook's client-side wall and unreadable via WebFetch/verifier, so it neither confirms nor contradicts; my WebSearch budget for this session was exhausted before I could hunt a second, fully independent outlet (e.g. Libyan press covering the same announcement), so tier is medium (one strong, directly-naming operator-source) rather than high. Diameter and Capacity remain unsourced by this article and are left blank rather than guessed. StartLocation/EndLocation are currently blank in the sheet (only country=Libya on both ends) even though the source names both ends (Fargh field → Sarir station) — flagged as a fill below.
